purpose: Deterministic full-interval catch-up. A process is never considered settled merely because its first overdue boundary was resolved.
closure_target: exact reached world time or earlier hard player interrupt
selection_order: globally earliest unresolved due/trigger time first; deterministic tie order by process id unless a registered dependency overrides it
scheduled_loop: collect all active processes with next_due <= target
resolve earliest boundary from that process settled_through to boundary
if owner remains autonomous and plan completes, create/activate lawful successor immediately
advance recurrence to a strictly later next_due
reinsert process/new processes and continue until no due boundary <= target
continuous_residual: After all full boundaries, every active unblocked process with accrual_mode=continuous settles its remaining span from settled_through through exact target without moving its anchored next_due.
new_process_rule: Any process created or activated at time <= target must itself be settled/caught up through target unless completed, paused, blocked, or stopped by player interrupt.
hard_interrupt_rule: At a required player choice, stop at the interrupt timestamp and make that the reached world time. Never simulate beyond it.

recurrence_kinds.calendar_month_start: advance to first day of next calendar month at registered clock
recurrence_kinds.calendar_month_end: advance to last day of next calendar month at registered clock
recurrence_kinds.calendar_quarter_start: advance to first day of next calendar quarter at registered clock
recurrence_kinds.calendar_quarter_end: advance to last day of next calendar quarter at registered clock
recurrence_kinds.calendar_year_start: advance to first day of next calendar year at registered clock; historical calendars have no year zero
recurrence_kinds.one_shot: after resolution process completes or is superseded; no automatic recurrence
recurrence_kinds.triggered: no next_due; resolve whenever registered trigger becomes true

accrual_modes.continuous: all elapsed time counts, including final partial interval
accrual_modes.boundary_only: state changes only on due boundary/trigger; no invented partial-cycle result

postconditions: no unresolved triggered condition with trigger_time <= world_time
continuous active unblocked processes settled_through == world_time
every newly activated process caught up through world_time
every evolving owner has process coverage
no elapsed eligible development/resource/recovery time lost
autonomous_action_rule: At every autonomous review or causal wake-up, evaluate lawful next actions from current goals, knowledge, authority, resources, location, opposition, and standing orders. Material actions instantiate an operation/mission/event before resolution and remain inside catch-up through the target time.

efficiency_policy.baseline: Coarse monthly and quarterly ecosystem clocks handle inactive or slowly accruing owners. Owners with active plans, orders, contracts, operations, or unresolved commitments are not inactive: they receive the daily autonomous-world heartbeat or an earlier exact causal wake. Material movement, battle, contract change, leadership change, information delivery, threshold crossing, or player contact wakes affected owners immediately. Dormant event archetypes are not polled monthly.
